name: pXt
source: A short concept piece based around using only freely available resources. Tells the love story of Pyramus and Thisbe, which is a part of [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pyramus_and_Thisbe]Roman mythology[/url].
translation: 一部仅使用免费素材制作的短篇概念作品。讲述了[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pyramus_and_Thisbe]罗马神话[/url]中皮拉摩斯与提斯柏的爱情故事。
